candidates.description: This vector represents common Japanese kanji characters and text tokens used in Japanese writing.
This vector represents short, capitalized or lowercase alphanumeric strings ending in a consonant-vowel-consonant phonetic pattern resembling names or acronyms.
This vector represents names, abbreviations, or words starting with the letters "K" or "kar".
This feature represents the phoneme sequence "sh" as a subword unit across various names and words.
This feature activates on various types of quotation marks, punctuation marks, and parentheses used in text formatting.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'y' and Japanese-related romanized syllables and proper nouns containing it.
This vector activates for tokens containing the lowercase vowel 'u' preceded by various consonants, often functioning as sub-word units or suffixes in diverse contexts.
This feature vector activates on alphanumeric subword tokens and fragments associated with Latin script characters, slashes, and typographical symbols.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing quotation marks, parentheses, and period punctuation marks at the ends of sentences or clauses.
These Italian adverbs and modifiers express degree, time, and logical relations.
